Sofía Bozán
Sofía Bozán ( 5 November 1904 – 9 July 1958) was an Argentine film actress and tango performer of the 1930s and 1940s. She made almost 30 appearances in film between 1937 and 1959. She began her career in acting in 1931 and appeared in films such as" Puerto nuevo" in 1936 and" Loco lindo"( 1937) and" Muchachas que estudian" in 1939. She also appeared in the tango film" Arriba el telón o el patio de la morocha" in 1951 as herself. She was the sister of Elena Bozán. Sofia Bozán died of cancer only aged 53 in 1958.
